author: Angela A.
message: I had ordered this for a friend of mine - & she absolutely LOVES it! She said that she can use everything within the box - even the box itself. The packaging was so colorful & vibrant! Thank you so much.
replyMessage: We are SOO HAPPY to hear that your friend LOVED the cancer care package you sent her. We hope it brought her lots of comfort and smiles. Blessings

author: Tracey K.
message: I ordered a basket twice for relatives who were navigating through their treatments. Each basket got rave reviews and were so appreciated by the recipients. They contained everything from snacks to puzzles. Everything for comfort in their time of need. Even queasy pops to help ease the chemo side effects. I also must note the great communion after I ordered. I misspelled a word on the card and was contacted to ensure accuracy. Excellent customer service and even some kind words of encouragement! If you want to help someone going through cancer treatments and don't know how, send them a basket full of love. There are baskets for folks going through radiation or chemo or both! It's a great way to show your support in a difficult time and they're affordable, reasonably priced and shipped quickly!

author: Sharon M.
message: A friend and I ordered a large women's chemo basked for our friend's daughter, who is facing a grueling chemo protocol this year. She was so thrilled and touched to receive this basket, and everything in it was so well thought out, from the puzzles to the tasty treats, and all the pragmatic stuff in between! We can't say enough about the Rock the Treatment gift baskets. Would certainly recommend.

author: K. I.
message: This was the best thing I could get for my boss's wife. I also received a personal thank you email from Ms. Stacy Berk. The box was an excellent choice. I didn't have to search around, everything she needed was in the box. Thank you so much. This box totally rocked.!! Bless you all.
